ITEM PARAGRAPHS
Members
of
staff
who
wish
to
turn
up
and
do
a
simple
job
and
go
home
is
relatively
happy
if
they
believe
their
work
is
secure
.
However
,
any
employee
who
wants
to
acquire
more
varied
and
responsible
duties
will
not
feel
satisfied
for
long
staying
with
the
same
and
boring
job
.
People
want
to
keep
working
hard
only
if
there
are
opportunities
for
promotion
to
a
more
challenging
job
.
If
this
opportunity
does
not
exist
,
they
are
most
likely
to
be
demotivated
.
